name: openEDMDelay
description: Beat-synced eight-tap delay with ping-pong, digital, tape, BBD and lo-fi modes, selectable high/low-pass slopes, ducking and glitch effects.

name: openWallLimiter
description: Five limiter characters with selectable high/low-pass filters, true-peak protection and LUFS loudness metering.

name: openGlitchFX
description: Beat-synced 32-step glitch sequencer for buffer stutters, reverse slices, tape stops, and pitch shifts.

name: openEDMFilter
description: Dual multimode filters with tempo-synced modulation, envelope followers, and analog-style drive.

name: openKicker
description: 12-note tuned kick drum synth with Locked-In WAV caching, Beat-4 synced reverse, bitcrush FX, and auto build patterns.

name: openFruit
description: 16-track sample tracker and step sequencer with pitch detection, 1/16-1/64 micro-timing, semitone tuning, and four-pattern pages.

name: openClapper
description: EDM and Trance clap synth with multi-burst flam, 12-note chromatic tuning, impact distortion, gated reverb, and brickwall limiter.

name: openSausage
description: Four-knob saturation, reverb, pitch rise, and stereo width processor with selectable saturation algorithms.

name: openDucker
description: Host-synced and free-running rhythmic ducking with four recovery curves, six beat rates, and audition trigger.

name: openTunerEQ
description: Five-band musical equalizer with note tuning, chromatic snapping, and interactive spectrum display.

name: openBassSpace
description: Low frequency stereo width processor. Adjust frequency cutoff and width from mono to extra-wide.

name: Winamp Classic Equalizer
description: Ten-band equalizer plugin with 4Front EQ10 and Constant-Q modes.

name: Winamp Classic Visualizer
description: Classic spectrum analyzer and oscilloscope display plugin.
